description.en: The ID of the GA instance.

description.zh:
全球加速实例所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the GA instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

descriptions.zh:
在调用该接口前，请注意： 

- 仅支持删除后付费实例。

- 如果要删除独享型实例，在删除实例前，请先将实例中的后端服务器解绑。

- 如果要删除共享型实例，在删除实例前，请先将实例中的EIP移除。
descriptions.en:
When you call this operation, take note of the following items:

*   You can delete only pay-as-you-go instances.
*   Before you can delete a dedicated instance, disassociate the backend server from the instance first.
*   Before you can delete a shared instance, disassociate the elastic IP address (EIP) from the instance first.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc delete-global-acceleration-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-acceleration-instance-id ga-asdfsl22s0000 --region cn-hangzhou
